name: airtable
description: Read/write the SportsCopilot Airtable base (Groups, Members, Events, RSVPs).
notes: Create a personal access token at https://airtable.com/create/tokens with data.records:read + data.records:write and schema.bases:read scopes on the SportsCopilot base. Put it in AIRTABLE_API_KEY (never commit it). Verify the exact package/tool names against the current Airtable MCP server docs.
